# Version 4.151.0 (Unreleased)
> **Graphite GPU backend and new platform support**

## Highlights

The next SkiaSharp release adds the Graphite GPU backend, async pixel readback, and a new Vulkan Silk.NET package. Graphite brings bindings for the modern Skia GPU backend across Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn. A new `SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET` package wires Vulkan up end-to-end. Async `RequestReadPixels` lands on both `SKImage` and `SKSurface`. Memory leaks in `SKRegion.SpanIterator` and `SKPixmap.ExtractSubset` are fixed, and several performance optimizations reduce allocations further.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Engine

- **Upstream m151 stability syncs** — Multiple upstream chrome/m151 fix merges are included, keeping the bundled engine current with Skia's stable branch. ([#4538](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4538), [#4568](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4568), [#4537](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4537))

## API Surface

- **Graphite GPU backend bindings** — New bindings expose Skia's next-generation Graphite GPU backend for Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn, enabling access to the modern rendering pipeline. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3968](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3968))
- **Async `RequestReadPixels` on `SKImage` and `SKSurface`** — A new backend-neutral async API lets callers read pixels from GPU-backed images and surfaces without stalling the GPU pipeline. ([#4545](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4545))
- **New `SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET` package** — A dedicated package integrates SkiaSharp Graphite/Ganesh Vulkan rendering with the Silk.NET Vulkan bindings, and Vulkan integration tests now run on Android and Linux. ([#4527](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4527))
- **FreeType font support on Nano Server** — FreeType is now used as the font backend on Windows Nano Server, enabling text rendering in container workloads where GDI is unavailable. — ❤️ [@jeffska](https://github.com/jeffska) ([#4280](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4280))

## Bug Fixes

- **Native use-after-free in `SKRegion.SpanIterator` fixed** — The `SKRegion` backing object was not rooted across the span iterator's lifetime and could be freed by the GC mid-iteration, causing memory corruption. ([#4355](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4355))
- **Native use-after-free in `SKPixmap.ExtractSubset` and `With*` fixed** — The pixel-source `SKPixmap` was not kept alive across derived pixmap operations, leading to use-after-free. The source is now rooted for the derived pixmap's lifetime. ([#4558](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4558))
- **CoTaskMem pixel-buffer leak in `SKImage.Create` failure path fixed** — When the raster `SKImage.Create` overload failed after allocating the pixel buffer, the buffer was leaked. It is now freed on all failure paths. ([#4455](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4455))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **HandleDictionary reflection check cached** — The skip-registration reflection check in `HandleDictionary` is now cached on first call, eliminating repeated reflection overhead on every object registration. ([#4630](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4630))
- **SKData.SaveTo double-copy eliminated** — The `SKData.SaveTo(Stream)` path now writes the native buffer directly to the stream, removing an intermediate managed `byte[]` copy. ([#4550](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4550))
- **GetEncodedText null-terminated path avoids string allocation** — The null-terminated fast path in `GetEncodedText` no longer allocates an intermediate `string`. ([#4498](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4498))
- **SKRuntimeEffectUniforms lookup map pre-sized** — `SKRuntimeEffectUniforms` now pre-allocates its uniform lookup map to the known count, avoiding rehash allocations during effect setup. ([#4512](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4512))

## Platform

- **Containerized CI test legs added** — Test coverage now includes Azure Linux, Alpine/musl, and Windows Nano Server as first-class CI legs, catching platform-specific regressions earlier. ([#4515](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4515))
- **Solutions converted to `.slnx` format** — All `.sln` solution files have been migrated to the new `.slnx` format for improved tooling compatibility. ([#4528](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4528))
- **MSVC environment initialized once per native build on Windows** — The Visual C++ environment setup is now performed once at the start of a native build pass rather than once per compilation unit, reducing build times on Windows. — ❤️ [@mmitche](https://github.com/mmitche) ([#4570](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4570))
- **Binding generation made deterministic across platforms** — The SkiaSharp binding generator now produces identical output regardless of the host platform, preventing spurious diffs in CI. ([#4612](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4612))
